question: Pharmaceutical category retains or grows share of total sports advertising spend in 2026 despite RFK Jr. regulatory pressure on prescription-drug TV ads
resolution_criterion: Per Standard Media Index (SMI) or Magna Global category share data published for 2026, pharmaceutical advertising share of total sports TV ad spend ≥ 2025 share OR Variety/AdAge published industry summary confirms pharma category did not contract in 2026 sports advertising
